The Supply Agreement, and what it quietly leaves out

Not every delivery problem is the supplier's fault, and not every complaint leads to compensation. Carolina's job is to read each situation against the actual contract, not just what feels right.

Carolina Mendes · Procurement, Althea Industrial
01The Agreement

Leia uma vez com calma — as expressões em destaque são as que decidem cada caso lá embaixo.

Hua Li Chemical Supply
Supply Agreement · Industrial Chemical Products · Section 5: Delivery, Quality & Claims
Section 5 — Delivery, Quality & Claims

5.1 — Product Specification & Concentration

All products delivered under this agreement must conform to the concentration and purity specifications stated in the Purchase Order. In the event that delivered product deviates from the agreed specification by more than the stated tolerance of ±2%, the buyer may reject the batch and request a replacement or credit note within 7 business days of receipt, provided that a laboratory analysis report from an accredited third party is submitted. Concentration claims based solely on internal testing are not recognised under this clause.

5.2 — Shelf Life & Storage Responsibility

Hua Li guarantees product quality up to the expiry date printed on each IBC or drum, provided that the product is stored within the temperature and humidity conditions specified on the Safety Data Sheet. Any degradation resulting from improper storage on the buyer's premises, including exposure to direct sunlight, excessive heat, or contamination from incompatible substances, releases Hua Li from liability. Once a delivery is accepted in good condition and signed for, the buyer assumes full responsibility for the product's condition.

5.3 — Short Delivery & Quantity Disputes

Any discrepancy between the quantity stated on the delivery note and the quantity physically received must be reported to Hua Li in writing within 3 business days of delivery. Claims submitted after this period will not be entertained. The buyer is responsible for verifying receipt at the time of delivery. Quantity shortfalls acknowledged by Hua Li will be resolved by credit note or make-good on the next scheduled delivery, at Hua Li's discretion.

02Five Cases for Carolina

Para cada caso: leia a situação, consulte o contrato se precisar, e decida se é coberto ou não. Depois veja como Carolina responderia.

Case 1
Althea receives a 1,000-litre IBC of zinc chloride solution. The purchase order specified 72% concentration. Carolina sends a sample to an accredited external laboratory, which returns a result of 68.5% — well below the ±2% tolerance. She reports this to Hua Li on day 4 after receipt, including the lab report.
Althea Industrial
Laboratory Analysis Report · Batch #ZC-4471
ProductZinc Chloride Solution (ZnCl²)
PO Specification72% concentration (±2%)
Lab Result68.5% — below tolerance
Lab AccreditationABNT / ISO 17025
Date of ReportDay 4 after delivery
Covered — under 5.1, the lab result from an accredited third party confirms the deviation is outside tolerance, and the claim was submitted within 7 business days. This is exactly what the clause requires.
How Carolina replies to Kevin
"Kevin, I'm following up on Batch #ZC-4471. Our third-party lab has confirmed the zinc chloride concentration at 68.5%, which is outside the ±2% tolerance stated in our PO. I'm formally requesting a replacement batch or a credit note under Section 5.1. I'm attaching the accredited lab report for your records."
Case 2
Two weeks after receiving a delivery of ammonium chloride, Althea's production team notices that the flux solution is not performing as expected in the galvanizing bath. Carolina checks and finds that the drums were stored in an unventilated area exposed to direct sunlight for 10 days, which affected the product. She contacts Hua Li asking for a replacement.
From: Carolina Mendes <carolina@althea.com.br>
To: Kevin Chen <kevin@huali-supply.com>
Date: 14 days after delivery
Product quality issue — Ammonium Chloride, last delivery
Hi Kevin, I wanted to flag a quality issue with the ammonium chloride from our last delivery. Our production team has reported that the flux performance in the galvanizing bath has dropped significantly. We've checked the product and believe there may be a degradation issue. Could you advise on next steps? We'd like to request a replacement if possible.

Best,
Carolina
No lab report attached · No mention of storage conditions
Not Covered — under 5.2, degradation caused by improper storage on the buyer's premises releases Hua Li from liability. The drums were exposed to direct sunlight, which violates the storage conditions in the Safety Data Sheet. Once accepted in good condition, the responsibility shifted to Althea.
How Kevin responds to Carolina
"Hi Carolina, thank you for getting in touch. Based on the information provided, the delivery was accepted in good condition. Our Safety Data Sheet specifies storage away from direct sunlight and heat sources. Under Section 5.2 of our agreement, we're unable to process a replacement claim for degradation resulting from storage conditions on the buyer's site. I'm happy to discuss this further if needed."
Case 3
Hua Li delivers 20 drums of hydrochloric acid (HCl). The delivery note states 20 drums. When Althea's warehouse team counts the pallets, they find only 18 drums. Carolina reports the short delivery to Hua Li in writing on the same day, with photos of the pallets as received.
Althea Industrial — Goods Receipt Note
Delivery Note #HCL-2209
Short Delivery
ProductHydrochloric Acid 33% (HCl)
Ordered20 drums
Received18 drums — 2 missing
Reported to supplierSame day — written notification + photos
Covered — under 5.3, the short delivery was reported in writing on the day of delivery, well within the 3-business-day window. Carolina also has photographic evidence. Hua Li is required to resolve this by credit note or make-good on the next delivery.
How Carolina replies to Kevin
"Kevin, I'm following up on Delivery Note #HCL-2209. Our goods receipt confirms 18 drums received against 20 invoiced. I reported this in writing on the day of delivery and have attached photographic evidence. Under Section 5.3, I'd like to request a credit note for the 2 missing drums, or make-good on our next scheduled delivery. Please confirm your preferred approach."
Case 4
Althea's internal quality team tests a batch of zinc ammonium chloride flux and records a concentration slightly below spec. Carolina reports the issue to Hua Li on day 5, referencing only the internal test result. Hua Li responds that the batch was shipped within specification according to their own records.
From: Carolina Mendes <carolina@althea.com.br>
To: Kevin Chen <kevin@huali-supply.com>
Date: Day 5 after delivery
Flux concentration issue — Batch ZAC-0831
Hi Kevin, our quality team has tested the zinc ammonium chloride flux from your latest delivery and found the concentration slightly below our PO specification. We'd like to request a replacement or credit note.

Best,
Carolina
No third-party lab report · Internal test results only
Not Covered — as submitted. Under 5.1, concentration claims based solely on internal testing are not recognised. Carolina needs an accredited third-party lab report to make this claim valid. She should arrange external testing before resubmitting.
What Carolina should do next
"Kevin, I understand. We're arranging accredited third-party testing for Batch ZAC-0831 and will resubmit the claim with a certified lab report as required under Section 5.1. I'll come back to you within the 7-business-day window."
Case 5
Althea over-ordered flux solution last quarter and now has excess stock they cannot use before the expiry date. The product is in perfect condition, stored correctly. Carolina asks Hua Li if they can return the surplus drums for a credit note.
From: Carolina Mendes <carolina@althea.com.br>
To: Kevin Chen <kevin@huali-supply.com>
Date: 6 weeks after delivery
Return of surplus flux stock — credit note request
Hi Kevin, due to a change in our production schedule this quarter, we find ourselves with surplus flux solution that we will not be able to use before the expiry date. The product is in perfect condition and has been stored correctly throughout. Is it possible to arrange a return for a credit note?

Best,
Carolina
Product in good condition · Correctly stored · Expiry date still valid
Not Covered — under this agreement. Section 5 only covers delivery problems, quality deviations, and quantity disputes. Over-ordering is the buyer's responsibility. There is no return clause in this agreement for surplus stock. Carolina may negotiate a commercial return with Kevin separately, but the contract does not require Hua Li to accept it.
How Kevin responds
"Hi Carolina, I appreciate you reaching out. Our standard supply agreement does not include a return clause for correctly delivered product. That said, I'd be happy to explore a commercial arrangement on a goodwill basis. Could you let me know the quantities and batch numbers involved? No promises, but I'll see what I can do."

Plain English
Teacher's Note
"conform to" vs. "comply with"
Both mean "estar de acordo com", but they are not interchangeable in technical writing. "Conform to" is used for physical characteristics: size, concentration, shape, specification. "Comply with" is used for rules, laws, and procedures. A product conforms to a specification; a company complies with a regulation. Ambos significam "estar em conformidade com", mas não são intercambiáveis. "Conform to" é para características físicas (concentração, especificação). "Comply with" é para regras e normas.
"not be entertained" — formal rejection language
This is a fixed expression in formal commercial English meaning "will not be considered or accepted". It sounds impersonal and final. Students often try to say "will not be accepted" — which also works — but "not be entertained" is the stronger, more contractual phrasing that signals the matter is closed. Expressão formal em inglês comercial que significa "não será considerada/aceita". É mais definitiva e contratual do que "will not be accepted".

Speaking Practice · Procurement
When would you escalate?
5 cases · discuss with your teacher
Case 1
Escalate if supplier refuses

The lab confirms the zinc chloride is outside spec. Carolina has submitted the claim within 7 days with an accredited lab report. Hua Li has gone silent — no response after 5 business days.

Would you escalate this? To whom — and what would you say? Você escalaria essa situação? Para quem, e o que diria?

Useful language / Expressões úteis
"I need to flag a supplier issue that hasn't been resolved at my level."
Preciso reportar um problema com fornecedor que não foi resolvido comercialmente.
"We have a valid claim under Section 5.1 and the supplier hasn't responded."
Temos uma reclamação válida e o fornecedor não respondeu.
"At this point I think we need legal to step in."
Nesse ponto, acho que precisamos envolver o jurídico.
Case 2
Resolve commercially

The ammonium chloride degraded because Althea stored it under direct sunlight. Carolina knows the contract does not cover this — it is Althea's fault. Her manager asks for an update.

How do you report this internally? What do you say to your manager? Como você reporta isso internamente? O que diria ao seu gestor?

Useful language / Expressões úteis
"After reviewing the contract, this one is on us — the storage conditions weren't right."
Após revisar o contrato, esse caso é nosso — as condições de armazenamento não estavam corretas.
"We don't have a valid claim here. We need to write this off and review our storage procedures."
Não temos uma reclamação válida. Precisamos absorver o prejuízo e revisar nossos procedimentos.
"I'll make sure this doesn't happen again — I'm putting a storage checklist in place."
Vou garantir que isso não aconteça de novo — vou implementar um checklist de armazenamento.
Case 3
Resolve commercially

Two drums of hydrochloric acid are missing. Carolina has reported this in writing on the day of delivery with photos. Hua Li acknowledges the shortfall and offers a credit note. The amount is small — around 800 USD.

Is escalation needed here? How do you close this out professionally? É necessário escalar? Como você fecha isso de forma profissional?

Useful language / Expressões úteis
"The supplier has acknowledged the shortfall and offered a credit note — I'm accepting that."
O fornecedor reconheceu a divergência e ofereceu nota de crédito — estou aceitando.
"This has been resolved at my level. I'll document it and monitor the next delivery."
Isso foi resolvido no meu nível. Vou documentar e monitorar a próxima entrega.
"If this becomes a pattern, I'll flag it as a supplier performance issue."
Se isso virar um padrão, vou reportar como problema de desempenho do fornecedor.
Case 4
Escalate to get budget

The flux concentration is outside spec but the claim was rejected because only internal test results were submitted. To resubmit, Carolina needs to send a sample to an accredited external lab — which costs money and takes time.

How do you make the business case to your manager for the external lab test? Como você justifica o custo do laboratório externo para o seu gestor?

Useful language / Expressões úteis
"Our claim was rejected because we only used internal testing. To have a valid claim, we need an accredited lab report."
Nossa reclamação foi rejeitada por usarmos apenas testes internos. Para ter validade, precisamos de laudo acreditado.
"The lab test costs around X, but the claim value is significantly higher — it's worth pursuing."
O teste custa aproximadamente X, mas o valor da reclamação é bem maior — vale a pena.
"I need your approval to proceed with the external test before the 7-day window closes."
Preciso da sua aprovação para o teste externo antes que o prazo de 7 dias se encerre.
Case 5
Negotiate — no escalation

Althea over-ordered flux and the contract doesn't cover returns. Kevin has informally suggested he might help "on a goodwill basis." Carolina needs to decide whether to push for a commercial return or accept the loss.

How do you approach Kevin to negotiate a return that isn't covered by the contract? Como você aborda Kevin para negociar uma devolução que o contrato não prevê?

Useful language / Expressões úteis
"I understand this isn't covered under our agreement, but I'd like to explore whether we can find a practical solution."
Entendo que isso não está previsto no contrato, mas gostaria de explorar se podemos encontrar uma solução prática.
"We've been a reliable partner — I'm hoping we can handle this on a goodwill basis."
Temos sido um parceiro confiável — espero que possamos resolver isso de boa vontade.
"Would you be open to taking back the surplus against our next order?"
Você estaria aberto a reabsorver o excedente no contexto do nosso próximo pedido?
